remarks: Welcome to The Park Lane, one of Western New York’s most beautiful apartment buildings! Built in 1925 and located on Frederick Law Olmsted’s Gates Circle, it is listed on the National Registry of Historic Places. Apartment 6B, combines historic elegance with modern conveniences including an updated kitchen and 2 full bathrooms. Measuring 1849 square feet, this apartment has large and gracious spaces for entertaining or enjoying quietly. Hard wood floors throughout the apartment. With views north, west and east, there is always beautiful light filling the rooms. Enter into a welcoming foyer and hall with a coat closet and arched doorway to the Living Room. The large living room has built-in bookshelves and lower cabinets for storage. A beautiful mantle and fireplace (NRTC) are the focal points along with many windows overlooking the trees and rooftops of Lafayette Ave and Chapin Parkway. The Dining Room is very spacious as well. The fully updated kitchen has new appliances, neutral colors, and granite countertops and leads to a pantry with plenty of additional storage and the laundry room. Both bedrooms are large. The primary bathroom includes a tub while the second bedroom uses the hall bath which is brand new and has a no-step shower. The Park Lane has a concierge-staffed front desk 24 hours a day, valet parking, exercise area and a community room and library. Storage unit in the basement. Buffalo living at its best!
